name: Voxel Grid Density Estimation with Trilinear Interpolation
definition: A method to estimate the accumulated density (and implicitly color) along a ray by sampling a 3D voxel grid. It uses trilinear interpolation to retrieve voxel values (density, color components) at arbitrary ray sample positions and then aggregates these values using a transmittance-based opacity formula.
summary: Voxel Grid Density Estimation with Trilinear Interpolation estimates ray density by sampling a 3D grid with trilinear interpolation, producing smooth boundaries without the lumpy artifacts of discrete sampling.
